description: Critical semantic mutants of the gate. Each plants ONE defect by an exact anchor in a sandbox copy of its file (never the tree), runs the probe group named by `probe` against that copy, and is KILLED only when the probe fails and every failing assertion is one listed in `expect`. A crash, or a red on any other assertion, is a WRONG-REASON kill and counts against the suite. Assertion names are written here by hand so they cannot shrink with the probes.

mutants.name: a judge verdict with no exit status is accepted
expect: acceptance: a judge verdict with no exit status is refused

mutants.name: a judge verdict is accepted from any process that was not signalled
expect: acceptance: a judge verdict from a process that exited 1 is refused
acceptance: a judge verdict with no exit status is refused

mutants.name: a judge verdict from a killed process is accepted
expect: acceptance: a judge verdict from a killed process is refused

mutants.name: a missing runner record is filled in as agreeing with the chain exit
expect: acceptance: a chain exit with no runner record is INDETERMINATE

mutants.name: a runner record that disagrees with the chain exit is ignored
expect: acceptance: a runner record that disagrees with the chain exit is INDETERMINATE

mutants.name: a chain killed by a signal is graded by its exit code
expect: acceptance: a chain killed by a signal is INDETERMINATE

mutants.name: a release ignores the fencing token
mutants.from: const tokenOff = token !== null && token !== undefined && held.meta.token !== token;
expect: locking: a release carrying a stale fencing token frees nothing

mutants.name: a release ignores the run id
mutants.from: const runOff = Boolean(runId) && Boolean(held.meta.runId) && held.meta.runId !== runId;
expect: locking: a release naming another run frees nothing

mutants.name: a fenced release frees the lane anyway
mutants.from: if (fence) return { released: false, fenced: true, why: fence };
mutants.to: if (false) return { released: false, fenced: true, why: fence };
expect: locking: a release carrying a stale fencing token frees nothing
locking: a release naming another run frees nothing

mutants.name: a lock carrying another run's id confirms ownership
expect: authority: a lock carrying another run id confers no ownership

mutants.name: a lock naming another pid confirms ownership
mutants.from: if (!now || now.pid !== pid) return { ok: false,
expect: authority: a lock naming another pid confers no ownership

mutants.name: no harness cap: a harness gate takes the last lane
mutants.from: return held + 1 > cap ? { held, cap, lanes: lockPaths.length } : null;
expect: admission: with no product waiting a harness gate is still refused the second of two lanes
admission: a harness gate is refused the last free lane while a product gate waits

mutants.name: admission never consults the reserve
mutants.from: const reserved = live[0].cls === HARNESS ? harnessReserve(lockPaths, lockPath) : null;
expect: admission: with no product waiting a harness gate is still refused the second of two lanes
admission: a harness gate is refused the last free lane while a product gate waits

mutants.name: the removed borrow: the cap applies only while a product waits
mutants.to:
function harnessReserve(lockPaths, lockPath) {
    if (!lockPaths.some((lp) => liveQueue(queueDirFor(lp), 600000, () => {}, lockPaths[0]).some((t) => t.cls === PRODUCT))) return null;
expect: admission: with no product waiting a harness gate is still refused the second of two lanes

mutants.name: a PASS is accepted when HEAD appears only in an earlier run
expect: release binding: a gate receipt whose PASS run names another head is refused

mutants.name: a wrapper run that starts with another head is accepted
expect: release binding: a wrapper receipt whose run starts with another head is refused

mutants.name: a fast-lane receipt for another head is accepted
expect: release binding: a fast-lane receipt for another head is refused

mutants.name: a receipt whose run skipped an expected suite is accepted
expect: completeness: a receipt whose run never ran an expected suite is refused

mutants.name: a receipt with no outcome for an expected suite is accepted
expect: completeness: a receipt with no outcome for an expected suite is refused

mutants.name: a receipt saying pass over a failed outcome is accepted
expect: completeness: a receipt saying pass over a failed outcome is refused

mutants.name: a suite that left no coverage dump is accepted
expect: completeness: a suite that left no coverage dump is refused

mutants.name: steps after the failed one read pass
expect: evidence: steps after the failed one read NOT RUN
evidence: a step started with no end on disk reads LOST and later steps NOT RUN
evidence: the runner's record carries the ledger of every step

mutants.name: a failed step keeps no output tail
expect: evidence: the failed step carries its exit and output tail
evidence: a step's output tail is bounded and marked truncated
evidence: an output sink failing with ENOSPC keeps the step's evidence

mutants.name: the output tail is unbounded
expect: evidence: a step's output tail is bounded and marked truncated

mutants.name: output goes to the sink before the tail, so a failing sink loses it
expect: evidence: an output sink failing with ENOSPC keeps the step's evidence

mutants.name: the runner's record drops the ledger
expect: evidence: the runner's record carries the ledger of every step

mutants.name: missing step records read as pass
mutants.from: status: STATUS.UNKNOWN, exit: null, signal: null, pid: null, tail: null, why }));
mutants.to: status: STATUS.PASS, exit: null, signal: null, pid: null, tail: null, why }));
expect: evidence: missing step records read UNKNOWN, never pass

mutants.name: a step with a start and no end is not reported lost
expect: evidence: a step started with no end on disk reads LOST and later steps NOT RUN

excluded.name: the whole-receipt head check is removed
excluded.why: equivalent: every receipt it refuses is also refused by the per-run head checks B1 and B2 guard, so no probe can tell it apart; it fails earlier, not differently
